shortDescription: Create/Cleanup an alternate rootvg disk on a VIOS

options.name: disk_size_policy
options.description: When I(state=copy), specifies how to choose the alternate disk if I(targets) is not specified. C(minimize) smallest disk that can be selected. C(upper) first disk found bigger than the rootvg disk. C(lower) disk size less than rootvg disk size but big enough to contain the used physical partitions. C(nearest) disk size closest to the rootvg disk.

options.name: force
options.description: Forces removal of any existing alternate disk copy on target disks. valid only for I(state) = C(copy)

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: Username and Password credential of the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The IP Address or hostname of the HMC.

options.name: state
options.description: C(copy) to create alternate rootvg disk. C(clean) to cleanup an existing alternate disk copy.

options.name: system_name
options.description: The name or mtms (machine type model serial) of the managed system.

options.name: targets
options.description: Provided with C(copy), an alternate rootvg will be created on these targets. Provided with C(clean), it removes the owning volume manager from the target disk(s).
